segments.text: Every action on a public chain leaves a trace.
Fluton is a confidential execution layer.
Fully homomorphic encryption lets contracts compute on encrypted values.
Zero-knowledge proofs check that an action is valid, without revealing your notes.
Inside the pool, value moves as private notes.
What stays public is explicit: deposits and withdrawals still show the amount, the token and the address.
Public rails. Private actions. Fluton. Testnet only.
